title: On mixed $b$-concatenations of Fibonacci and Lucas numbers that are Lucas numbers
summary: Let $(F_n)_{n\ge0}$ and $(L_n)_{n\ge0}$ denote the sequences of Fibonacci and Lucas numbers respectively. This paper determines all Lucas numbers that can be represented as base $b$ mixed concatenations of a Fibonacci number and a Lucas number. Mathematically, we study of two Diophantine equations $L_n=b^dL_m+F_k$ and $L_n=b^dF_m+L_k$, where $d$ is the number of digits of $F_k$ or $L_k$ in base $b$.
